SELECT p.POST_ID , p.TITLE , U.NAME , p.STATUS , p.RECRUIT_CNT , ts.TECH_STACK_CD , rs.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM , cs.COMMENT_CNT , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID ='PROGRESS_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = P.PROGRESS_TYPE_CD) AS PROGRESS_TYPE_CD , p.VIEW_CNT , TO_CHAR(p.RECRUIT_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS RECRUIT_END_DATE , CASE WHEN p.RECRUIT_END_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEADLINE_OVER FROM POST p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG(pts.TECH_STACK_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pts.TECH_STACK_CD DESC) AS TECH_STACK_CD FROM POST_TECH_STACK pts GROUP BY POST_ID )ts ON p.POST_ID = ts.POST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG( (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE CMM_CODE_DTL.COM_CD_ID = 'RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD' AND CMM_CODE_DTL.DTL_CD_ID = prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD DESC) AS RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM FROM POST_RECRUIT_POSITION prp GROUP BY POST_ID )RS ON p.POST_ID = RS.POST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM "COMMENT" WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY POST_ID )cs ON p.POST_ID = cs.POST_ID
AND (UPPER(P.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(P.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM POST_RECRUIT_POSITION prp2 WHERE prp2.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND prp2.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD = #{recruitPositTypeCd} )
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC

SELECT p.POST_ID , p.USER_ID , p.TITLE , P.CONTENT , P.PROGRESS_PERIOD , U.NAME , p.STATUS , p.RECRUIT_CNT , p.RECRUIT_TARGET , ts.TECH_STACK_CD , rs.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM , (SELECT DTL_CD_ID FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID ='PROGRESS_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = P.PROGRESS_TYPE_CD) AS PROGRESS_TYPE_CD , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID ='PROGRESS_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = P.PROGRESS_TYPE_CD) AS PROGRESS_TYPE_NM , p.VIEW_CNT , TO_CHAR(p.RECRUIT_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS RECRUIT_END_DATE FROM POST p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG(pts.TECH_STACK_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pts.TECH_STACK_CD DESC) AS TECH_STACK_CD FROM POST_TECH_STACK pts GROUP BY POST_ID )ts ON p.POST_ID = ts.POST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG( (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE CMM_CODE_DTL.COM_CD_ID = 'RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD' AND CMM_CODE_DTL.DTL_CD_ID = prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD DESC) AS RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM FROM POST_RECRUIT_POSITION prp GROUP BY POST_ID )RS ON p.POST_ID = RS.POST_ID
p.POST_ID = #{postId}

SELECT PRP.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID = 'RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = PRP.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD) AS RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM , PRP.RECRUIT_CNT , COUNT(PA.APPLY_ID) AS CURRENT_CNT FROM POST_RECRUIT_POSITION prp LEFT JOIN POST_APPLY PA ON PRP.POST_ID = PA.POST_ID AND PRP.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD = PA.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD AND PA.STATUS_CD = '20' WHERE PRP.POST_ID = #{postId} GROUP BY PRP.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD, PRP.RECRUIT_CNT
